name: CORBON 2017 Shared Task
description: Shared-task benchmark evaluating projection-based coreference resolution methods, providing data and evaluation protocols for comparison.
reputation: Well-regarded within the coreference research community for evaluating projection-based approaches, but niche compared to mainstream coreference benchmarks.
notes: Focused on projection-based coreference; relatively specialized/small-scale compared to large modern corpora; not primarily designed for evaluating LLMs—risk of limited coverage and language-specific artifacts.
